secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app ID — found in the Base44 builder app settings; used by the @base44 SDK to identify the backend app

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base44 backend URL — found in the Base44 builder app settings (e.g. https://<app>.base44.app); the vite plugin proxies /api there

secrets.name: AUTOMATION_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret authorizing scheduled/system backend function and workflow invocations — set in the Base44 dashboard Secrets; consumed at runtime via base44/shared/automationSecret.ts (getAutomationSecret). Rotate it only in the dashboard: no code change needed.
